description: c/n 316-20. Formerly displayed at NAS Cubi Point and moved to Marikit Park between December 2009 and October 2011 after falling into disrepair and being covered in graffiti. Repainted during the move into a NASA-style scheme copied from A-5A 147858 'WST858', with orange tail striping, so its visible markings are not its own. Ex-USS Kitty Hawk, coded NH-605.
